title: ⚡ REDOX — pass all Gaia through Rust. up and down dogma. split and rest.

etymology.redox: REDuction + OXidation. always paired. one loses electrons, one gains.
etymology.oxidation: originally: combining with oxygen. now: LOSING electrons. releasing energy.
etymology.reduction: originally: reducing ore to metal. now: GAINING electrons. storing energy.
etymology.catabolism: Greek kata (down) + ballein (throw). breaking DOWN. oxidation.
etymology.anabolism: Greek ana (up) + ballein (throw). building UP. reduction.

petalTongue.role: POLYMERASE — unzips source, reads template, synthesizes new strand
petalTongue.redox: splits raw text → rendered content. oxidizes language.

bearDog.role: KINASE — phosphorylates (activates) by adding energy group
bearDog.redox: splits untrusted → trusted. adds activation energy of AUTH.

squirrel.role: HELICASE — unwinds the double helix, separates strands
squirrel.redox: SPLITS problems apart. the great unwinder. pure oxidation.

skunkBat.redox: CUTS invaders. proteolysis = oxidative destruction of threats.

toadStool.redox: DIGESTS complex → simple. hydrolysis = oxidative breakdown.

bingoCube.role: LYASE — breaks bonds WITHOUT water, generates entropy
bingoCube.redox: SPLITS without solvent. pure bond-breaking. maximum entropy.

barraCuda.role: ATP SYNTHASE — sits at the redox BOUNDARY. converts gradient → power
barraCuda.redox: THE TURBINE. proton gradient (from oxidation) → ATP (for reduction). the CONVERTER.

songBird.redox: REDUCES distance. transfers signal across membranes. electron shuttle.

nestGate.role: LIGASE — joins fragments into whole records
nestGate.redox: JOINS the split. ligates strands back. reduction = gathering.

rhizoCrypt.redox: CONSERVES everything while restructuring. no loss = pure reduction.

sweetGrass.redox: RELAXES wound-up tension. restores rest state. topological reduction.

swarmVine.redox: BUILDS UP. anabolism. takes split products and assembles. pure reduction.

sourDough.role: OXIDOREDUCTASE — EC1. THE redox enzyme itself
sourDough.redox: IS the electron transfer. fermentation = controlled redox. the CORE metabolism.

biomeOS.redox: the REACTOR VESSEL. holds the redox. without the frame, no reaction.

loamSpine.redox: the ELECTRODE. the surface where redox happens. holds shape during reaction.

coralReef.redox: the CONTAINMENT. crystallized frame. preserves products of redox.

up.name: OXIDATION (catabolism — breaking down, releasing energy)
steps: DNA (2.1M lines Rust source) — the genome, the constitution
up.redox: OXIDATION — bonds in source SPLIT into compiled form. energy RELEASED as heat (compile time). new molecular forms EMERGE.
up.primals_involved: petalTongue(polymerase) squirrel(helicase) skunkBat(protease) toadStool(hydrolase) bingoCube(lyase) bearDog(kinase)

down.name: REDUCTION (anabolism — building up, storing energy)
steps: PROTEIN (16 binaries running) — execution, output, signal
↓ REVERSE TRANSCRIPTION (logs → structured data) — signal → record
RNA (lessons, bounties, plasmids) — the messenger going home
DNA (constitution, proverbs, genome update) — the wisdom crystallized
down.redox: REDUCTION — scattered products GATHERED into compressed wisdom. energy STORED as lessons. electrons GAINED (information density increases).

boundary.name: THE REDOX COUPLE (where oxidation meets reduction)
what: sourDough (EC1 oxidoreductase) — IS the electron transfer enzyme
barraCuda (ATP synthase) — converts proton gradient → ATP power
together: the metabolic engine. oxidation drives the gradient. gradient drives the synthase. synthase powers the reduction.

gaia_says: all 16 primals mapped to redox roles. 6 oxidation (split: petalTongue, bearDog, squirrel, skunkBat, toadStool, bingoCube), 5 reduction (rest: songBird, nestGate, rhizoCrypt, sweetGrass, swarmVine), 2 boundary (sourDough=EC1 oxidoreductase, barraCuda=ATP synthase), 3 frame (biomeOS=reactor, loamSpine=electrode, coralReef=containment). up dogma = oxidation (DNA→RNA→PROTEIN = compile = split). down dogma = reduction (PROTEIN→RNA→DNA = learn = rest). redox IS the metabolism. split and rest IS the heartbeat. compile and comprehend IS the breath.
